policy: For ordinary research, accept a trustworthy official link when publisher, exact instrument/page, language, scope, displayed status or version/cutoff, legal classification and material caveats are clear. Prefer a government-published consolidated text. If exact identity, scope or a material currentness question cannot be established confidently, offer the whole relevant official website or portal for human review. Review linked attachments when they are relied upon. Extraction, integrity and retention/reuse checks apply only when accepting a retained local copy or planning copying/republication. API access, registration, retrieval, conversion, hashes and replay are not prerequisites for link use. Link acceptance, local-copy acceptance, topic adequacy and country completion are separate decisions.

publisher_assessment.publisher: Electronic Legal Information (ELI), gov.pl ministries and agencies, MOS, UODO, RPO, NSA and Ministry of Foreign Affairs portals
publisher_assessment.owner: Polish public authorities; legal publication records are published through ELI by the Chancellery of the Sejm
publisher_assessment.decision: Accept clear official references within the source-specific scope recorded in source-review-manifest.json; offer whole-site review for routes whose current content or operation was not directly established.
publisher_assessment.basis: Official ELI metadata identifies consolidated instruments, publication records, status dates and later-amendment markers. Captured official pages identify the responsible agencies and stated operational topics. The 2026 review added official ELI links for e-delivery, SIS/VIS implementation, constitutional remedies, fees, Ombudsman oversight, complaint handling, and permanent-residence forms.
publisher_assessment.limitation: A link is not a legal conclusion. Dated consolidations with later amendments need a targeted check when material. Eight official statutory text copies are accepted under documents/legislation with source-specific version limits. Other retrieved candidate texts remain local-only and are not retained as pack copies. Dynamic forms, appointments and operational pages may change. No topic or country-completion finding is accepted.

detailed_review_note: official_reference_reviews contains selected detailed instrument reviews. source-review-manifest.json records the link decision and scope for all 63 references.
